verdict.rationale: Database branching is a fair question for a database product like ClickHouse, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents instant copy-on-write branches of schema and data. Adjacent items such as exporting backups, pushing local development to cloud, and running local servers do not amount to branching, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an instant copy-on-write branch of my database — schema and data — to develop and test against production-shaped data
